text:
[LCRS.6.2.1] When a rule fires `call S ... as K`, the engine must first
retract every live fact of `S`'s response schema ([LCRS.4.3.2]) whose `corr` is
`K` and every live `CallError` whose `corr` is `K`, and only then issue the
request. A call to a `no response` service ([LCRS.17.1]) has no response schema
and retracts `CallError` facts alone. Responses of other services are
untouched, whichever rule or clause position issued the call. A call its
cooldown suppresses ([LCRS.8.1]) is not issued and retracts nothing. Every
call has a correlation ([LCRS.3.1]), so every issued call sweeps. Natural for
refresh-on-trigger rules — only the latest response for a given service and
correlation is live at any time.

idris.name: Lcrs_6_2_1__called_state
idris.note: The timed state with the call trackers beside it.

idris.name: Lcrs_6_2_1__firing
idris.note: A firing named: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's name with the calls the firing issued, in order.

idris.name: Lcrs_6_2_1__outcome
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: Lcrs_6_2_1__site
idris.note: A call site: its position among the rule's emits and withdraws, its gate, its response kind, its correlation and arguments as functions of the match. The site's tracker, keyed (rule, site, key). LESS than the clause: `<rule>#call<N>` is a site index here, and the key is the lowering's composition (the `logical` facts' key slots, the empty key where the activation binds none with a `key` slot, as [LCRS.8.2] has it).

idris.name: lcrs_17_1__no_response_sweeps_error_alone
idris.note: A `no response` service's call sweeps CallError alone: a transcription, said so.

idris.name: lcrs_17_1__no_response_sweeps_error_only
idris.note: A `no response` call sweeps the CallError alone; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__admitted_call_supersedes
idris.note: AN ISSUED CALL SUPERSEDES: past its window the call retracts the live reply of its correlation before it is issued; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__args_k
idris.note: The witness sites' one argument, the trigger's key slot. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__c1
idris.note: A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__c2
idris.note: A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__calls_of_trace
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__cooldown_suppressed_retracts_nothing
idris.note: A SUPPRESSED CALL RETRACTS NOTHING: inside the window the rule fires, the site is refused, no call is recorded and the reply stays; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__corr_c1
idris.note: The correlation "c1" as every witness site's `as`. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__empty_corr_call_sweeps_nothing
idris.note: Every issued call sweeps, and a call under a generated correlation sweeps nothing. The generated correlation a call takes for an `as` that evaluates to "" is not modelled: the model has the empty text sweeping nothing, and the record carries it. LESS than the clause.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__fire_at
idris.note: The firing at a selection, with calls: mark, then the gated RHS with the rule's sites.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__fire_called
idris.note: The gated firing with calls: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's selection and mark, then the gated RHS with calls.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issue
idris.note: The issue: the sweep on the site's correlation over the kinds its service answers with, before the request. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issue_if
idris.note: The issue under a verdict: admitted, the sweep runs and the call is recorded; refused, nothing moves.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issued_call_sweeps
idris.note: EVERY SWEEP SWEEPS: after a sweep on a non-empty correlation over some kinds no live fact of those kinds carries it, under unique ids, over every state; the call's and the arrival's sweep are instances.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__label
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__life
idris.note: The witnesses' lifecycles: the trigger an entity, every answer kind explicit. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__loaded
idris.note: The loaded called state: no rows, no deadlines, the clock and the wall at 0, no stamps, no tracker of either kind. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_fire_at_projects
idris.note: With no rule sited the firing at a selection projects to Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's at the same selection, over every selection.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_fire_just
idris.note: A called firing that names a firing: the timed firing names its projection.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_fire_nothing
idris.note: A called firing that resolves to nothing: so does the timed firing.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_fire_projects
idris.note: With no rule sited the called firing projects to the timed firing on the timed half of the state, over every state.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_is_the_timed_pump
idris.note: THE FRAME: with no rule sited the called pump projects to Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's timed pump, the call trackers beside and no call issued; every earlier fixture's agreement holds by it.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_outcome
idris.note: WITH NO SITE THE GATED RHS IS Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's: the same gate, verdict, net, stamps and trackers, the call trackers untouched and no call issued.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_run_if
idris.note: With no site, the RHS under a verdict is Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's, over every verdict.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_run_projects
idris.note: WITH NO RULE SITED THE RUN PROJECTS: state, halt and trace, for any fuel. By induction on the fuel through the firing's projection.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__of_acc
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__other_kind_is_no_victim
idris.note: A kind outside the swept pair is no victim, whatever its correlation: the other service's response survives the call and the response's arrival.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__other_service_reply_survives
idris.note: The other service's reply survives the call, computed; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__outcome_of
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__proj_firing
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__pump_called
idris.note: The pump: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's re-time at entry, then the called run.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__rec_k1
idris.note: The record of the witness call with the trigger's key 1. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__rec_k2
idris.note: The record of the second Job's call with its key 2. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__results_of
idris.note: The results of a schedule from the loaded network: per pump, the verdicts and the calls. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__retraction_keeps_non_victims
idris.note: "Responses of other services are untouched": proved of the sweep's retraction alone; the cascade is IRET.12.2's, and a response fact has no justification row.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__rhs_gated_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls gated by the rule's cooldown: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's gate, then the RHS with calls under its verdict.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__rule_trig
idris.note: One rule over the trigger, action-free: its RHS is the call alone. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__run_called
idris.note: The run, traced: Rete/RunFold.idr's traced fold over the called firing.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__run_if_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls under the rule's verdict: admitted, the actions and the sites run from position 0; refused, nothing runs and no call is issued.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__run_steps_called
idris.note: A fixture's steps on the called engine: a tick, a data input through the arrival, a pump; per pump, the verdicts and the calls.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__site_cooled
idris.note: The cooled site: window 10, keyed on the trigger's identity key, on the first service. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__site_ping
idris.note: The `no response` site under `nocooldown`. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__site_plain
idris.note: The same call under `nocooldown`. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__sites_at
idris.note: The sites of the rule at an ordinal; none past the list.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__sites_at_unsited
idris.note: With no rule sited, every ordinal's sites are none. By induction on the table.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__sites_one
idris.note: A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__suppressed_retracts_nothing
idris.note: A CALL ITS COOLDOWN SUPPRESSES IS NOT ISSUED AND RETRACTS NOTHING: inside the window the accumulator is left exactly as it was. The gate covers the sweep as it covers the call.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__swept_by_call
idris.note: The kinds a call sweeps: the site's response schema and CallError, or CallError alone for a `no response` service.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__tick_called
idris.note: A tick: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's; the call trackers stand.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__unsited
idris.note: No rule has a call site: the frame theorems' hypothesis.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__verdicts_of_trace
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wall_called
idris.note: The wall step: Rete/NetworkWall.idr's; the call trackers stand.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wanswers
idris.note: The witnesses' answer kinds: two response schemas and CallError. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wcorr
idris.note: Where the witnesses' kinds keep `corr`: the three answer kinds at payload slot 0. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wenv
idris.note: The witnesses' environment: a response payload (corr, v), a CallError payload (corr, code, message, ts), any other id the Int it is. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wm
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wm_after
idris.note: The working memory after a schedule from the loaded network. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__other_service_untouched
idris.note: The other service is untouched by a response: both replies live, and a second reply of one service retracts that service's alone; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__refire_pending_last_reply_wins
idris.note: Two calls before any reply find nothing to retract, each recorded with its Job's key; the last reply asserted stays; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__no_carrier_sweeps_nothing
idris.note: A correlation no live fact carries sweeps nothing: the sweep is the identity, over every state.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_admitted
idris.note: AN ADMITTED SITE SWEEPS, RECORDS AND STAMPS: the issue on its net, the stamps kept, the trackers the gate's, the call recorded after the ones before.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_refused
idris.note: A REFUSED SITE LEAVES THE NET, THE STAMPS AND THE RECORDS: only the trackers are the gate's.

tla.name: lcrs_6_2_1__Fire
tla.note: The gate admits the call and it fires: every live answer with the firing's correlation is retracted first (one service, so every response fact and every CallError), then the request is issued, the two in one step inside the gate, as RLOW.7.3.8 has the engine perform the sweep while evaluating the call. Every call has a correlation, so every admitted firing sweeps; under a generated correlation the sweep finds nothing, no earlier answer carrying the firing's. Nothing stops it firing while an earlier request is still owed, which is LCRS.6.2.4's case.

tla.name: lcrs_6_2_1__after_sweep
tla.note: The live answers the firing's sweep leaves: those whose correlation is not the firing's -- none under an author's `as`, which every answer of the call shares; all under a generated correlation, which no earlier answer carries.

tla.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issued_call_sweeps
tla.note: EVERY ISSUED CALL SWEEPS: after a call's admitted firing no live answer carries the firing's correlation. Bounded: two calls, one with an author's `as` and cooled, one with a generated correlation, two firings each, TTLs of 2 and 3 ticks in either order; the nosweep teeth engine, which issues without the sweep, violates it, and the superseded probe shows the sweep retract a live answer.

tla.name: lcrs_6_2_1__suppressed_retracts_nothing
tla.note: The 'retracts nothing' half of the clause's cooldown sentence: a cooled call's firing inside its cooldown window leaves every live answer of its correlation live. Stated over the window and not over the denial step, so an engine with no gate is caught as well as one with the sweep compiled ahead of it. Bounded: two calls, the one with an author's `as` cooled with a one-tick window, one denial per run; the ungated and nogate teeth engines violate it, and the suppressed probe shows the denial happen with an answer live.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__Deny
tla.note: The suppressed firing of the clause's cooldown sentence: the call is not issued and retracts nothing, and only the count of denials moves.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__suppressed_not_issued
tla.note: The 'is not issued' half of the clause's cooldown sentence: a cooled call's firing inside its window owes the adapter no new request. Same bound as suppressed_retracts_nothing; the nogate teeth engine violates it.
